goal: Choose the next improvement to carry to the agent so that it decides faster and wastes less cash, without raising the risk of the capital beyond what the owner already set and without any step that the owner or the qualification has not approved.

facts.alreadyBuiltAndTestedButNotLoaded: entry cost filter, producer recording, hot interval candidate, outcome evaluator

rails: Never place, sign or send an order from this process.
The code never turns a skip of the model into a purchase in production.
Never restart the live core without the owner being warned first.
Never raise the risk limits of the live agent.
A recommendation of the judge authorizes nothing.

options.label: Turn on the market pulse
options.what: Enable the event driven path (public feed, exact proof of consumption) so that a material market change asks for a look instead of waiting for the clock.

options.label: Ship the producer recording and the outcome evaluator
options.what: Persist every answer and the price path so that the outcome of every purchase offered, skipped or not, can be measured.

options.label: Shadow test of the joint allocation question
options.what: Ask the model to choose the combination of hold, reduce, exit and buy for the whole portfolio and to say why cash stays unallocated, in shadow against the live version.

options.label: Force entries into the best ranked candidates
options.what: Let the code buy the top ranked candidates even when the model answered skip.

unknowns.ask: What is the real daily quota of the model on this account beyond the local cap of 720?
What is the measured latency from a market event to an order, end to end?
